entries.text: You see a strong, stout man with a bushy beard.
entries.source_text: You see a strong, stout man with a bushy beard.

entries.text: You see MacRae.
entries.source_text: You see MacRae.

entries.text: Hello Lad, what might you be looking for today?
entries.source_text: Hello Lad, what might you be looking for today?

entries.text: Hello Lass, what might you be looking for today?
entries.source_text: Hello Lass, what might you be looking for today?

entries.text: Ai, What else would you be looking to know?
entries.source_text: Ai, What else would you be looking to know?

entries.text: Who are you?
entries.source_text: Who are you?

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Blades?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Blades?

entries.text: Nothing, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks.

entries.text: Well, I'm MacRae.  I help the Blades some against the Deathclaws and that Regulator bunch.  Teach'em a bit about protectin 'emselves against those nasties.
entries.source_text:
Well, I'm MacRae.  I help the Blades some against the Deathclaws and that Regulator bunch.
  Teach'em a bit about protectin 'emselves against those nasties.

entries.text: What kind of stuff do you teach them?
entries.source_text: What kind of stuff do you teach them?

entries.text: Have you seen the Deathclaws?
entries.source_text: Have you seen the Deathclaws?

entries.text: What's the deal with the Regulators
entries.source_text: What's the deal with the Regulators

entries.text: Can I ask you something else?
entries.source_text: Can I ask you something else?

entries.text: Well m' specialty is fightin with my fists, and takin a punch or two more than the guy throwin 'em at me.
entries.source_text:
Well m' specialty is fightin with my fists, and takin a punch or two more than 
the guy throwin 'em at me.

entries.text: Sounds like a dumb idea, I'd rather use a gun.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a dumb idea, I'd rather use a gun.

entries.text: Do you think you could teach me anything?
entries.source_text: Do you think you could teach me anything?

entries.text: Can I ask you something else?
entries.source_text: Can I ask you something else?

entries.text: Well if that's how you be feeling, you can just turn yourself around and walk away.
entries.source_text: Well if that's how you be feeling, you can just turn yourself around and walk away.

entries.text: You seem to be an alright lad, but me times busy with keeping the Blades schooled.  If things were to straighten themselves, I might be havin the time then.
entries.source_text:
You seem to be an alright lad, but me times busy with keeping the Blades schooled.  If 
things were to straighten themselves, I might be havin the time then.

entries.text: Alright, can I ask you something else?
entries.source_text: Alright, can I ask you something else?

entries.text: Thanx for the info.
entries.source_text: Thanx for the info.

entries.text: Seen em I have.  Ran like hell, I did.  If yer lookin for 'em, you'll find 'em over there. [MacRae points over to the east]
entries.source_text:
Seen em I have.  Ran like hell, I did.  If yer lookin for 'em, you'll find 'em over there. 
[MacRae points over to the east]

entries.text: I was thinkin the Deathclaws were the spawn of an unnatural act, but 'em Regulators are evil.  Come once a month or so and they shows their ugly faces and drag a father away from is wee ones.
entries.source_text:
I was thinkin the Deathclaws were the spawn of an unnatural act, but 'em Regulators are evil.  
Come once a month or so and they shows their ugly faces and drag a father away from is wee ones.

entries.text: Anything I could do to help?
entries.source_text: Anything I could do to help?

entries.text: Sounds bad, could I ask you another question?
entries.source_text: Sounds bad, could I ask you another question?

entries.text: Thanks for the info.
entries.source_text: Thanks for the info.

entries.text: You be wantin to talk to Razor.  A good lass if there ever was one.
entries.source_text: You be wantin to talk to Razor.  A good lass if there ever was one.

entries.text: A good group of people is what the Blades are.  Stuck ere between the damn Regulators and the Deathclaws ain't meant the happiest life for em, but they survive.
entries.source_text:
A good group of people is what the Blades are.  Stuck ere between the damn Regulators and the 
Deathclaws ain't meant the happiest life for em, but they survive.

entries.text: [MacRae claps you on the back] Thanks to you, the Blades are going to live a better life.  So, what can an old Scotsman do for ya?
entries.source_text:
[MacRae claps you on the back] Thanks to you, the Blades are going to live a better life.  So, 
what can an old Scotsman do for ya?

entries.text: You had said earlier that if you had some free time, you could teach me a few things.
entries.source_text: You had said earlier that if you had some free time, you could teach me a few things.

entries.text: What have you been doing lately?
entries.source_text: What have you been doing lately?

entries.text: What do you do around here?
entries.source_text: What do you do around here?

entries.text: Not a problem.
entries.source_text: Not a problem.

entries.text: Well it's been a wee bit quiet since the Blades helped out Adytum with the Regulators.  Me teaching services haven't been in such demand.
entries.source_text:
Well it's been a wee bit quiet since the Blades helped out Adytum with the Regulators.  Me 
teaching services haven't been in such demand.

entries.text: What do you teach?
entries.source_text: What do you teach?

entries.text: Sorry to hear that, hope things get more interesting?
entries.source_text: Sorry to hear that, hope things get more interesting?

entries.text: Could you teach me?
entries.source_text: Could you teach me?

entries.text: Sounds interesting, but I gotta get going.
entries.source_text: Sounds interesting, but I gotta get going.

entries.text: Well I guess I do have the time.  Might as well start right now. [MacRae starts showing you some fighting stances, and ways to take punches like a true Scotsman.]
entries.source_text:
Well I guess I do have the time.  Might as well start right now. [MacRae starts showing you some 
fighting stances, and ways to take punches like a true Scotsman.]

entries.text: You be a quick learner.  Hope that helps you in your travels.
entries.source_text: You be a quick learner.  Hope that helps you in your travels.

entries.text: Well I used to be helpin the Blades out by teachin them a few things about protectin themselves against the DeathClaws and the Regulators.  Now with you takin care of all that, things have been a wee bit on the boring side lately.
entries.source_text:
Well I used to be helpin the Blades out by teachin them a few things about protectin themselves 
against the DeathClaws and the Regulators.  Now with you takin care of all that, things have been a wee 
bit on the boring side lately.

entries.text: Good seein ya.
entries.source_text: Good seein ya.
